bio.text: Lee McInnis is the Democratic candidate for Alabama's 3rd Congressional District in 2026.
McInnis was born in Birmingham, Alabama, and served in the U.S. Army from 1983 to 1989.
McInnis earned a bachelor's degree from Auburn University in 1983 and graduate degrees from Auburn in 1987 and 2024.
McInnis's career experience includes work as an intelligence officer and lead instructor.
